name: divider
summary: Separates related content with an optional aligned label and horizontal or vertical orientation.

agent.useWhen: A visible rule materially clarifies content grouping or sequence.

invariants: Configuration supplies orientation, alignment and optional literal label; there is no server-data binding, browser-local state or event output.
The app owns grouped content and composition; server patches replace the separator as ordinary markup without mount or unmount hooks.
Dividers are noninteractive and expose role separator with their horizontal or vertical aria-orientation.
Horizontal dividers may have a nonblank text label aligned start, center, or end; vertical dividers cannot have labels. Label alignment is start, center, or end, defaulting to center.
Unlabelled horizontal dividers render as one uninterrupted rule.
Label text is HTML-encoded in both visible content and the accessible name.
The adapter fragment contains exactly one [[attributes]] slot and one [[label]] slot. The target adapter expands both slots using the typed catalog renderer.

tokenDescriptions.name: --cui-divider-gap
tokenDescriptions.purpose: Controls spacing between elements for divider.

tokenDescriptions.name: --cui-divider-label-edge
tokenDescriptions.purpose: Controls visual treatment for label divider.
